items.title: US launches new strikes as Iran says civilian infrastructure hit
items.description: Tehran says the US strikes hit bridges, while the US boards a ship in the Strait of Hormuz.

items.title: Trump alleges China meddled in 2020 election and questions voting security ahead of midterms
items.description: China said Trump's claims were fabricated and US Democrats said he was paving the way to undermine November's elections.

items.title: More than 500 Rohingya vanished at sea - what happened?
items.description: Two boats carrying an estimated 530 Rohingyas have disappeared since leaving Myanmar on 29 June.

items.title: Japan relaxes royal succession rules - but ban on female emperors remains
items.description: The law now allows the adoption of male distant relatives aged over 15 back into the imperial family.

items.title: Philippines condemns monkey video on Chinese media as racist
items.description: The AI video on China Daily showed a monkey in Philippine garments singing its claims to the South China Sea.

items.title: Trump Media to sell instant access to 'market-moving' social posts
items.description: Trump Media is launching a fast, paid feed to its most influential posts for Wall Street traders.

items.title: School bus crash kills at least 20 pupils in Uganda
items.description: Dozens others, including school staff, were injured in the crash, suspected to have been caused by a mechanical fault.
